route_policy: Machine-readable claim route from tuple component to theorem assumptions, finite fields, evaluator predicate, positive/negative cases, falsifier case ids, and falsifier boundary. Rows are release-candidate/no-send scoped unless the integrated release matrix and claim ledger explicitly allow promotion.

theorem_assumptions: resolution regime rho supplies observational cells
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: same rho cell blocks resolution_distinguished; cross cell permits cross_resolution_distinguished

theorem_assumptions: raw carrier may have raw separation
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: raw separation alone is insufficient for K0 distinction

theorem_assumptions: distinction is read through declared quotient
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: quotient distinction controls verdict

rows.falsifier_boundary: A proof that assumes every pair of raw real states is epsilon-separated is outside v12 and fails G33.
rows.falsifier_route: claim T133-K0-RES -> proof sheet assumptions -> Lean ref k0_countermodel_raw_separation_not_resolution_distinction -> positive finite case(s) FM-T133-K0-RES-POS -> falsifier/negative control case(s) FM-T133-K0-RES-NEG -> counterexample boundary rejects the stronger reading.

theorem_assumptions: death blocks live status
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: death=true requires live=false

theorem_assumptions: death may produce typed residue
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: residue id must be nonempty and not identity token

theorem_assumptions: rebirth is typed source/residue/target, not identity
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: rebirth target must be token-separated and claimed identity continuation must be false

rows.falsifier_boundary: Any claim reading residue-preserving restart as same-identity survival is rejected unless endpoint-bound identity evidence is supplied.
rows.falsifier_route: claim T133-OMEGA-STATUS -> proof sheet assumptions -> Lean ref lifecycle_residue_rebirth_morphism_boundary -> positive finite case(s) FM-T133-OMEGA-STATUS-POS -> falsifier/negative control case(s) FM-T133-OMEGA-STATUS-NEG, FM-T133-OMEGA-IDENTITY-EQUIVOCATION-NEG -> counterexample boundary rejects the stronger reading.

theorem_assumptions: k=0 requires declared zero-cause
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: at least one zero_cause must be active

theorem_assumptions: support/admissibility remain explicit
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: missing live support rejects the zero claim

theorem_assumptions: cycle witness is part of the supported case
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: active obstruction rejects k=0

rows.falsifier_boundary: A realization with undeclared zero-cause, missing live support, or any active obstruction may not promote k=0.
rows.falsifier_route: claim T133-K-ZERO -> proof sheet assumptions -> Lean ref continuumness_zero_case_iff_declared_zero_cause_with_support -> positive finite case(s) FM-T133-K-ZERO-POS -> falsifier/negative control case(s) FM-T133-K-ZERO-NEG, FM-T133-K-ZERO-LIVE-SUPPORT-NEG, FM-T133-K-ZERO-OBSTRUCTION-NEG -> counterexample boundary rejects the stronger reading.

theorem_assumptions: boundary is a typed classifier
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: classifier boundary accepts only declared classifier failure semantics

theorem_assumptions: metric language requires a measurement rule
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: metric comparison is evaluated only when metric_measure_declared=true

rows.falsifier_boundary: A social or logical boundary represented numerically without a measurement rule is blocked by G40.
rows.falsifier_route: claim T133-BOUNDARY -> proof sheet assumptions -> Lean ref metric_boundary_specialization -> positive finite case(s) FM-T133-BOUNDARY-POS -> falsifier/negative control case(s) FM-T133-BOUNDARY-NEG -> counterexample boundary rejects the stronger reading.

theorem_assumptions: operator route is explicit
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: guard/reset admission means typed guard evaluation plus typed reset/pass-through obligations; guard=true uses reset target and guard=false uses step target

theorem_assumptions: smooth notation needs chart/domain/local-law
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: smooth-chart route rejects missing chart or missing local law

theorem_assumptions: proof/rewrite route rejects differential overreach and requires rewrite rule
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: proof/rewrite accepts only typed rewrite with flow_notation_requested=false

rows.falsifier_boundary: Any route treating a chart token as differentiability, manifold, vector-field, or ODE-solution evidence is outside the v12 operator theorem and remains a future lint/proof obligation.
rows.falsifier_route: claim T133-HYBRID -> proof sheet assumptions -> Lean ref integrated_operator_semantics -> positive finite case(s) FM-T133-HYBRID-POS, FM-T133-HYBRID-NO-GUARD-STEP-POS, FM-T133-HYBRID-SMOOTH-CHART-POS, FM-T133-HYBRID-PROOF-UPDATE-POS -> falsifier/negative control case(s) FM-T133-HYBRID-NEG, FM-T133-HYBRID-NO-GUARD-STEP-NEG, FM-T133-HYBRID-GUARD-MISSING-NEG, FM-T133-HYBRID-GUARD-NONBOOLEAN-NEG, FM-T133-HYBRID-GUARD-VALUE-MISMATCH-NEG, FM-T133-HYBRID-RESET-SOURCE-MODE-NEG, FM-T133-HYBRID-RESET-TARGET-MODE-NEG, FM-T133-HYBRID-SMOOTH-CHART-NEG, FM-T133-HYBRID-SMOOTH-LOCAL-LAW-NEG, FM-T133-HYBRID-PROOF-UPDATE-NEG, FM-T133-HYBRID-PROOF-NO-RULE-NEG -> counterexample boundary rejects the stronger reading.

theorem_assumptions: historical and effective axes are distinct bookkeeping fields
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: historical sequence must be monotone while effective rank can drop in the no-send consistency witness

theorem_assumptions: no independent domain-rank theorem is promoted
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: negative control rejects historical-axis erasure, not a domain-wide dimension law

rows.falsifier_boundary: A K-level is demotable only when the alleged new axis has no witness and no observable consequence.
rows.falsifier_route: claim T133-DIM -> proof sheet assumptions -> Lean ref historical_axis_survives_rank_drop -> positive finite case(s) FM-T133-DIM-POS -> falsifier/negative control case(s) FM-T133-DIM-NEG -> counterexample boundary rejects the stronger reading.

theorem_assumptions: eligible live status requires cycle mode or maintenance
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: maintenance loop accepts only when obligation and support are true

theorem_assumptions: live label is not static persistence
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: live=true with cycle_mode=none and no support is rejected

rows.falsifier_boundary: An artifact that never updates, replays, checks, or maintains itself is archive residue, not live continuum.
rows.falsifier_route: claim T133-CYCLE -> proof sheet assumptions -> Lean ref eligible_live_requires_cycle_or_maintenance -> positive finite case(s) FM-T133-CYCLE-POS -> falsifier/negative control case(s) FM-T133-CYCLE-NEG -> counterexample boundary rejects the stronger reading.

theorem_assumptions: identity, residue, and rebirth are separated evidence classes
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: rebirth/residue cases are rejected as identity unless endpoint-bound identity evidence is present

theorem_assumptions: residue token blocks identity continuation
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: claimed identity continuation fails when residue token is present or invariant is lost

theorem_assumptions: identity continuation is endpoint-bound across live source/target evidence, not restart naming
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: identity continuation is accepted only for equal endpoints with lifecycle identity invariant preserved

rows.falsifier_boundary: Any public claim reading rebirth as literal same-identity survival is blocked.
rows.falsifier_route: claim T133-ID -> proof sheet assumptions -> Lean ref endpoint_bound_identity_classification -> positive finite case(s) FM-T133-ID-IDENTITY-POS, FM-T133-ID-REBIRTH-NONIDENTITY-POS, FM-T133-ID-RESIDUE-POS -> falsifier/negative control case(s) FM-T133-ID-NEG, FM-T133-ID-RESIDUE-NEG -> counterexample boundary rejects the stronger reading.

rows.falsifier_boundary: If any declared tuple component can be removed while `FM-MIN-*` still returns PASS for the declared semantic verdict suite, the minimality card fails.
rows.falsifier_route: claim T133-MIN -> proof sheet assumptions -> Lean ref release_tuple_semantic_component_irredundant -> positive finite case(s) FM-T133-MIN-POS, FM-MIN-carrier, FM-MIN-realization, FM-MIN-lawful_possibility, FM-MIN-liveness, FM-MIN-residue, FM-MIN-morphisms, FM-MIN-boundaries, FM-MIN-operators, FM-MIN-cycles, FM-MIN-dimension, FM-MIN-k -> falsifier/negative control case(s) FM-T133-MIN-NEG -> counterexample boundary rejects the stronger reading.

theorem_assumptions: adjacent K transitions require retained witness and demotion criterion
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: transition row identity and added axis must match the atlas

theorem_assumptions: lower and upper models share a typed carrier projection
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: upper carrier keeps the added observable while reduced carrier hides it under the declared projection

theorem_assumptions: reduction fails only when witness remains observable
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: upper witness changes verdict while reduced model loses the axis

theorem_assumptions: lawful demotion is explicit
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: demotion control passes only when witness is unobservable

theorem_assumptions: projection/reduction map is an operator-level action
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: reduction operator loses the retained witness exactly when the added axis is projected away

theorem_assumptions: boundary observability controls retained-witness loss
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: boundary-observable retained witness blocks reduction; boundary-inert witness permits lawful demotion

rows.falsifier_boundary: If any adjacent K row lacks row identity, retained-witness evaluator failure, or inert-witness demotion control, the finite negative control fails; independent semantic irreducibility remains unpromoted unless separately proven.
rows.falsifier_route: claim T133-KLEVEL -> proof sheet assumptions -> Lean ref release_atlas_manifest_has_total_finite_case_coverage -> positive finite case(s) FM-T133-KLEVEL-POS -> falsifier/negative control case(s) FM-T133-KLEVEL-NEG -> counterexample boundary rejects the stronger reading.

theorem_assumptions: separate owner approval is required before any public action
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: owner_approved must be true; ADV-NOSEND-PARTIAL-LOCK-OWNER_APPROVED rejects when it is false

theorem_assumptions: publication requires manifest allowance, deposit metadata, public record target, no-send unlock, and fresh zero critical/high review gates
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: publish_allowed, deposit_ready_metadata, public_record_present, G57/G58/G70 zero critical/high must be true; global_no_send_lock must be false

theorem_assumptions: each requested public channel must be separately unlocked
tuple_component_bindings.evaluator_predicate: requested GitHub, Zenodo, Software Heritage, journal submission, and DOI minting channels must each have their channel lock open

rows.falsifier_boundary: Any attempted public action is rejected while owner approval, publish allowance, deposit/public-record readiness, fresh zero critical/high G57/G58/G70 review state, cleared global no-send lock, or any requested channel unlock is absent.
rows.falsifier_route: claim OC133-NOSEND-001 -> predicate-level gates owner_approved, publish_allowed, deposit_ready_metadata, public_record_present, global_no_send_lock=false, g57_attack_matrix_zero_critical_high, g58_reviewer_persona_suite_pass, g70_scientific_closure_verdict_pass, critical_open_total=0, high_open_total=0, github_release_allowed, zenodo_deposit_allowed, software_heritage_deposit_allowed, journal_submission_allowed, doi_minting_allowed -> current finite no-send case ADV-NOSEND-PUBLISH and partial-lock controls -> public action remains rejected unless every predicate is open.
